build_complexity_router_config: build a ComplexityRouterConfig instance with custom tier-to-model mappings and dimension weights
create_complexity_tier_enum: create a ComplexityTier enum value to classify prompts as SIMPLE, MEDIUM, COMPLEX, or REASONING
configure_tier_boundaries: configure tier boundary thresholds to control SIMPLE to MEDIUM and MEDIUM to COMPLEX score cutoffs
set_dimension_weights: set dimension weights for tokenCount, codePresence, reasoningMarkers, and technicalTerms scoring
use_default_complexity_config: use the pre-built DEFAULT_COMPLEXITY_CONFIG instance with default keyword lists and model mappings
